scope: All version-controlled packages/**/*.go Test/Benchmark/Fuzz declarations in *_test.go at the pinned baseline; browser/JS/scripts/app tests excluded. Test-only Go support inventory preserved.
audit_limit: Only entries with audit_status=reviewed were classified. Null decisions are explicit unread/incompletely-reviewed inventory and were preserved. This is a focused reviewed removal batch, not a claim that every low-signal package test has been found.

environment.build_coordination: Baseline validated by root; no Go build/test run by this package agent. Parent serializes integrated candidate validation after storage recovery.

reproduce_body_checksums: Read each baseline file with git show BASE:path; SHA-256 each complete declaration from func through its matched closing brace, ignoring braces in Go strings/comments while scanning.
ci_routing: scripts/ci/affected.py maps packages edits to packages + Go + both apps. No required check, coverage threshold, protection, or gate route changed.

baseline.authority: Parent root reported exact baseline Go sources at 876b771a7dd0aef5e65957fcee87add0312535e8

e2e_artifact: Parent-owned integrated revision/run artifact is required before delivery; this ledger contains coverage mapping, not executed E2E proof.
failure_analysis_first: No new isolated tests, production code, or replacement assertions added in this batch.

apihttp.e2e: Genuine populated app library/admin/product journeys execute real registration and JSON handlers; malformed JSON, wrapped sentinels, missing adapters, and refresh failures are not exhaustive in E2E.

validation.e2e: Populated connection/supporter flows use ordinary valid configuration. No browser E2E equivalence for exhaustive token grammar and trust-boundary configuration rejection.

dlna.e2e: No current populated browser journey acts as a DLNA/SSDP client. Retained HTTP/UDP owner tests provide distinct protocol and local-media safety proof.

hlsmanifest.e2e: apps/player/e2e/playback-startup.spec.ts moves real media through populated server playback; decoder injections and synthetic fixtures elsewhere are explicitly not backend E2E. None exhaust malformed manifest, CR/LF, storage, nonfinite duration, or huge segment states.

navigation.e2e: Populated test-instance navigation editor and navigation-repeat journeys prove reachability/current links. They do not save every destination/move or test malformed forms and Accept quality boundaries.

localization.dependency_read: Cached github.com/nicksnyder/go-i18n/v2@v2.6.1/i18n/{message,bundle,localizer}.go types and AddMessages/NewLocalizer behavior inspected.
localization.e2e: Current populated browser fixtures do not exercise every supported locale, malformed template/attribute states, hostile picker values, or per-message allocation budgets.

playerweb.e2e: Genuine populated playback and curation journeys exercise normal rendering. player-experience-fixture.ts independently constructs markup/media objects and cannot prove server-side PlayerTemplate/PlayerData transformations or hostile input escaping.

webassets.e2e: Populated artwork journey measures frame geometry but not source pixel cropping/object-fit at arbitrary ratios. Browser asset consumption does not inject malformed unified stylesheet patches.

transcodepolicy.e2e: Populated playback verifies normal chosen media paths. Browser fixtures do not provide every target hardware platform/codec availability combination; policy readiness and catalog isolation remain distinct proof.

transcodehardware.e2e: Populated HLS playback uses actual initialization media. It is complementary to retained process-backed fake-FFmpeg/platform tests and injected verified-operation failures; no exhaustive physical GPU claim.

credentials.e2e: Genuine populated apps/player/e2e/ui-happy-paths.spec.ts:Owner can create and revoke an API key and manage a Viewer Profile and both apps test-instance.spec.ts MFA enrollment create current valid credentials; these do not inject malformed PHC, legacy hash, dictionary, or entropy failures. Password reveal/browser fixtures prove UI behavior only.

settings.e2e: Genuine populated ui-happy-paths API-key/profile flow proves valid settings issuance, and test-instance.spec.ts subtitle picker flow changes a distinct preference. These do not exhaust generic managed fields, failure injection, path/symlink escapes, malformed forms, or save/apply ordering. Browser player/settings fixtures independently provide their own HTML and responses.

documentdb.e2e: Genuine populated library/playlist/profile and playback journeys exercise successful durable state indirectly. apps/player/e2e/playback-startup.spec.ts:failed progress save does not stop playback flow aborts the browser route; it does not induce SQLite rollback. Offline browser progress tests use separate IndexedDB fixtures. No equivalence claimed for migration corruption, atomic multi-document/entry bounds, or concurrent export revisions.

servertransport.e2e: Browser app journeys require a running server but do not prove CLI loopback health protocol/error handling. App-local direct CheckHealth replay is redundant with TestCheckHealthCoversProtocolsAndInputFailures; app process healthcheck ownership remains independently tested.
